reasons.specificity: The comparison distinctly tracks the 2001 myth-cycle, money-paradox, and Marx–Schumpeter synthesis against the 2022 unbounded-markets, self-description, and property-rights framework.
reasons.anchoring: Nearly all interpretive claims are supported by accurate source quotations, especially the paralysis/unstoppability tension and the shift from weaning-off to containment.
reasons.non_obviousness: It usefully distinguishes substantive continuity from an explicitly claimed revision and identifies changes in causal support, force, epistemic function, and critical prescription.
reasons.coherence: The main reading and table are consistent, but the appended scope-review apparatus contradictorily labels completed readings “inconclusive” and “unchecked” while asserting verification and invented workflow records.
reasons.usefulness: The requested earlier/later/claimed-relation table is strong and reader-oriented, though the extensive findings and scope bureaucracy substantially obscures the central comparison.
reasons.hallucination_risk: The textual comparison is largely reliable, but claims about recorded assessments, handoffs, malformed ledgers, retained evidence, and internal IDs are unsupported by either supplied source.

decisive_errors.analysis_claim: The scope sections assert that assessments were “recorded” as “inconclusive” and “unchecked,” cite a “handoff,” malformed ledger rows, and retained-evidence failures.
decisive_errors.counter_passage: Neither source contains any scope-review record, handoff, ledger identifiers such as “D4.DOC1.F4,” verification status, or evidence-retention metadata; these are invented apparatus rather than source-supported findings.

score.one_line: An excellent, tightly anchored revision table and interpretation are materially weakened by a large block of fabricated review-workflow metadata.
